title: Anise, the Cotton Club dancer
summary: Albert spells Anise and describes her and her partner as the best dance team he saw.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: When the young lady called herself, Anise, How do you spell Anise? Anise, Anise, Anise, Anise, how do you spell Anise?
A-N-I-S-E, the original Cotton Club, she was a very beautiful girl, a real small, a petite, as they say. And Anise was a little fella, the most beautiful dance team I've ever seen.
